remarks: Fourth floor studio suite available for Fractional Ownership at the Tamarack Club. Located within walking distance to the main base area of Holiday Valley for skiing, ownership at the Tamarack Club will include year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, hot tubs, sauna, fitness center, underground parking while lodging overnight, valet parking, discounts on skiing and golf, and the flexibility to use your weeks, rent your weeks or a combo of both. Great views of the golf course, pool and slopes from the balcony. This particular Fraction will have 2 weeks in December of 2025.
